# Supabase browser SDK

Official `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.118.0**, installed from npm for this task.
`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unchanged `dist/umd/supabase.js` distribution (classic IIFE).
Loaded once, on demand, by `supabase-client.mjs`. No runtime CDN dependency or frontend build step.
